name: bestcastgroup-workspace
description: Full-stack application workspace with React frontend, Node.js/Express backend, and MongoDB Mongoose database.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.mongo:start: docker start mongodb || docker run -d --name mongodb -p 27017:27017 --restart unless-stopped mongo:6.0
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
